title: Monthly Ijtema
details: The monthly congregational gathering of Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah at Dar-ul-Irfan. Dates are announced on naqshbandiaowaisiah.org.

title: Salana Ijtema
details: The annual congregational gathering of Silsila Naqshbandia Owaisiah at Dar-ul-Irfan. Dates are announced on naqshbandiaowaisiah.org.

title: Ramadan Aitekaaf
details: Collective Aitekaaf observed at Dar-ul-Irfan during Ramadan. Dates follow the Islamic lunar calendar and are announced each year on naqshbandiaowaisiah.org.
